title: 👾 Workers / Avatars

current_candidate.summary: Geometric avatars replaced with image collage parts.

open_feedback: This is one of the biggest improvement opportunities.
Do not destroy useful mass/layout logic.
Replace geometric identity with modular image collage.
Mix heads, torsos, arms, legs, masks and props from real/cutout imagery.
Intentional asymmetry, missing legs and creepy mismatches are welcome.
Judge the crowd in mass, not only one polished avatar.
